summary: String section, slow attack: cinematic, ballads, trap and pop strings
label: string section
body: Long chords, the top voice moving; trap and drill use them dark and minor. Shorter: GeneralUser GS/Fast Strings; plucked: GeneralUser GS/Pizzicato Strings.

Register: MIDI 40-88 (openDAW names C3 = 60); outside it, it sounds wrong. Sound: GeneralUser GS/Slow Strings, a sampled instrument: make_instrument (sound "GeneralUser GS/Slow Strings") makes the track with its notes in one edit; apply makes it empty.
